item: D1 the NScript entity Main rows: PDB nesting and private virtual
evidence: Ego_r.pdb and FableWin.pdb nest every entity class in its script class and spell Main private virtual (EAE). The pred rows define ?Main@<entity>@@QAEXXZ or ?Main@<entity>@NScript@@QAEXXZ (0x00E8B020 UAE). Wave 26 nested only 0x00D9F270 (CMC_Minion in CQ_MinionCampScript), because its Leaf line already named the PDB nesting and matched no symbol: the verifier had been grading the largest function. Nesting is name-only; EAE is not (a virtual Main needs the entity vtable model).
decision needed: Should a naming wave nest the entity classes (name-only), and should EAE wait for the vtable model? 0x00D9F270 also keeps its #pragma inline_depth(0) region. That region was already there; c693 decision 3 routes it to the repair lane with 0x00EF87D0 / 0x00EF5CB0.

evidence: Ego_r.pdb / FableWin.pdb: Write overrides CDataOutputStream's virtual (UAE). The own row is a free __fastcall Write, and its binder 0x009A7720 calls it directly. engine/CFileDataOutputStream.h has no vptr, so the virtual cannot be declared on the shared header.
decision needed: Choose one: an opt-in retail layout in engine/CFileDataOutputStream.h with the CDataOutputStream vptr (as FABLE_RETAIL_BANK_FILE), or keep the row deferred.

item: D4 0x0098A9A0 / 0x00A5ECB0 CPixelShader: CArray<long> and private access
evidence: Ego_r.pdb: the ctor parameter is CArray<long>, and both members are private (AAE). Wave 26 re-modelled 0x0098A9A0's CLongArray as CArray<T> : std::vector<T>, the landed 0x00B1B380 model. This is so the caller names exactly what own row 0x00A5ECB0 defines (QAE, CArray<long>). It does not name the bare vector<long> spelling that vecify alone produced. BINDINGS adds that QAE spelling.
decision needed: Should the ctor and CreatePixelShader become private, with `friend class CShaderRenderManager`? Retail must have had the friend, because the manager calls the private ctor. If so, respell both rows and the binding.

item: D5 own-row Leafs on wave-26-touched rows that differ from the PDB
evidence: These rows were touched name-only by their vector model. Their own Leafs keep pre-wave access or parameters that Ego_r / FableWin spell otherwise. Six differ only in access: QAE->AAE/IAE, or QBE->QAE. Two need virtual (UAE/MBE). Four also change a parameter type: bool / CCharString& / CArray<CCharString> / vector<const CAnimationEntry*>.
decision needed: May a naming wave respell access-only Leafs, and their binders, as a name-only family? The virtual and parameter cases go to the re-model lane.

item: D6 the vector<long> grow-insert leftovers that move a second target
evidence: Each row's vector template also carries another target. 0x008865C0 carries vector<float>::_M_insert_overflow 0x004408A0. 0x00F3F5A0 carries 0x005135D0. 0x00F372B0 carries vector<CResourceEntry>::resize 0x00F385A0. 0x00774100 carries the _Vector_base / alloc_proxy and the copy ctor 0x00514160. 0x006BC4A0's own row is an out-of-class non-template by-value push_back(long). No STLport member has that shape, and its identity is unproven: it may be a CArray<long> member or a second copy.
decision needed: Approve per-row re-models that respell the second target in the same family. For 0x006BC4A0, decide its identity.

evidence: 0x004091C0's vector<T, Trivial> also instantiates the CDateAndTime grow-insert, so a second target would move. 0x004128A0 is vector<CWideString>::push_back: reloc_bindings binds ?push_back@?$vector@VCWideString@@V?$allocator@VCWideString@@@std@@@std@@QAEXABVCWideString@@@Z there, by 0x004917B5. But its own row is a Leaf-less free VectorPushBack over a VectorPushBackOverlay::InsertRange view. The allocator-less ?push_back@?$vector@VCWideString@@@std@@ by 0x005955AB is a second bound spelling of it.
decision needed: Same as D6: approve the two-target re-model of 0x004091C0. Re-author 0x004128A0 as the STLport member: an out-of-line push_back instantiation that calls 0x00412330. Then retire the allocator-less push_back spelling.
